payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_42d035c60003, pid 1334) active and waiting on Lock/transactionid, blocked by pid 1333 (session_2669d5a2d075), which is 'idle in transaction' after running the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and now waiting on ClientRead — an uncommitted transaction holding the row lock. No evidence of large data, index, or vacuum issues (single-row table, PK index only, tiny query times). Uncertainty: none material; the blocking chain is directly observed. Resolution path: rollback the eligible blocker session_2669d5a2d075 to release the lock, preserving the business request.
